about: The game windows' frames on a real display (EN2; D-187: a frame's p99 within 8.3 ms on this class of machine, CPU and GPU both counted), run by `omui-devtools bench windows --screen MONITOR`. Each window is built in the release profile (`dist`), opened on the monitor named (`--position`: the real pointer is not touched), given `setup` input once it has settled (keys, the button — the person's input, sent through its own agent endpoint, so the real keyboard and pointer are not used), then watched from outside its process for `span_ms` after `warm_ms`: DAMAGE gives each presented frame's time (the intervals between them), the process's processor time (mcpplibs.os) what it spends, nvidia-smi the share of the GPU's multiprocessors this process kept busy each second and the display's clocks. `repeat` input is sent every `every_ms` while it is measured. The window's own trace (`--profile`) says what its frame costs it, by the frame (the app's frame, the host's render and present): a diagnostic, named so in every report; SDL_GPU has no GPU timestamps (mlibs.rhi), so the GPU's per-frame time is the driver's mean, not a distribution.
